title: Potted Prize Chrysanthemums Displayed at Flower Show, c. 1940s Vintage Photo
description: A vintage black-and-white photograph capturing rows of meticulously cultivated, prize-winning chrysanthemum blooms presented at an indoor or tented horticultural exhibition. Each large, globose flower head is displayed with identification tags, set against a striped partition wall under canvas canopy lighting, reminiscent of traditional Japanese chrysanthemum shows (kiku matsuri).
